name: Comillas (Spain)
description: Horizontally divided white over dark blue, charged at the centre with the crowned arms of Comillas (a tower and a ship on blue, in an ornate frame).
history: The municipality has as symbols arms and a flag; the flag is formed of two horizontal stripes of equal width, the upper white and the lower dark (indigo) blue. In 2006 the municipality proposed to the Parliament of Cantabria the adoption of the Cantabrian lábaro as official flag of Cantabria and flies that flag from the balcony of the town hall during the local festivities.

features.role: Comillas arms — tower and ship in an ornate frame
